records.run: molecular law, HERACLES CO, FUV+24um, 750 pc

axes.xDefinition: log10 H2 surface density at 750 pc resolution, from CO(2-1) with N(H2)=2.0e20 Ico, hydrogen only (no helium)
axes.yDefinition: log10 SFR surface density from FUV + 24 micron (3.2e-3 I24 + 8.1e-2 IFUV), Kroupa-type IMF to 120 Msun

representation.equation: Sigma_SFR = a (Sigma_H2 / 10 Msun pc^-2)^N, log a = A = -2.12, N = 1.01; i.e. log Sigma_SFR = A + N (log Sigma_H2 - 1)

scatter.meaning: RMS scatter of log Sigma_SFR about the fit (stated in the text for this panel)

selection.population: pixels (750 pc sampling points) inside r25 of 7 nearby spirals with HERACLES CO and THINGS HI; Sigma_H2 > 3 Msun pc^-2
selection.warning: Molecular gas only (gasDefinition H2), sub-kpc resolved law: do not compare with a total-gas or galaxy-integrated KS law. The fit is normalised at 10 Msun pc^-2 (the prose ensemble law omits this). xMin is the stated CO sensitivity limit; xMax is the extent of the plotted data cells in Fig. 9 (digitized from the vector figure, not stated in the text). Fitted with the OLS bisector, equal weight per point.

definitions.areaScale: 750 pc resolution pixels (pixel-by-pixel sampling inside r25)
definitions.imfNote: paper: 'a Kroupa-type two-component IMF that extends to 120 Msun'; multiply Sigma_SFR by 1.59 for a truncated Salpeter IMF
definitions.coConversion: N(H2) = 2.0e20 Ico cm^-2 (K km/s)^-1 with I(2-1)/I(1-0) = 0.8, constant
definitions.heliumIncluded: no (hydrogen surface densities; multiply by ~1.36 for helium)

provenance.citation: Bigiel et al. 2008, AJ 136, 2846 (arXiv:0810.2541), Sec. 'The Combined Molecular Schmidt Law' and Fig. 9 (top left)

records.notes: N=1.01, A=-2.12, 0.19 dex scatter as published. Fig. 9 top-left drawn fit line: slope 1.006, value at log Sigma_H2 = 1: -2.118; at the frame edges (x=-1.00, 2.53) the published expression gives -4.140, -0.575 vs drawn -4.130, -0.579 calibration validated by the drawn 1%/10%/100% constant-SFE lines (unit slope, offsets log10(frac)-2+log10(1.36)); y scale 34.675 pt/dex, x scale 70.0 pt/dex data cells of the panel span log Sigma_H2 = 0.53..2.25; fit performed for Sigma_H2 > 3 Msun/pc^2 (log = 0.477) NOTE: the displayed ensemble equation Sigma_SFR = 10^-2.1 Sigma_H2^1.0 omits the 10 Msun/pc^2 normalisation of eq. 'power-law'; the figure confirms the normalised form
